# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen (Volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c6 P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c15 P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher
- **Titles:** Miss; Mrs. Inglis  <sub>[v4 c6 P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

She has lovely skin and curly brown hair, which she styles in a fashionable manner. She is well-built and plump, and is known for her loud weeping when emotional, though she is otherwise quiet and composed. At her wedding, she wore white satin, tulle, lace, roses, and orange blossoms, along with a prominent cluster diamond ring.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v3 c31 P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 c33 P7](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0007)_

## Personality

Odette is sensible, practical, and hardworking, holding a very realistic and unromantic view of life. She dislikes pretense and stays composed in situations where others panic. Though she is not overly imaginative or romantic, she is a kind, loyal, and supportive friend, known for being polite and unpretentious even after marrying into wealth.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v3 c31 P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005)_

## History

Odette Pullen grew up in Brierley and attended the local school. She was part of the older students' group preparing for Regent's Academy entrance examinations and was courted by the schoolmaster, Mr. Pidgeon. She was a member of the local youth circle, participating in Sunday-school events, picnics, and literary/story clubs. She passed her entrance exams alongside her peers and moved to Port Marlow to study at Regent's Academy. After completing her studies, she took a teaching position in Stonebridge. She later decided to move to western Canada to teach. While there, she met and married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Englishman with mining interests in Winnipeg. She returned home to Brierley briefly before her wedding, where she married Mr. Inglis in a grand ceremony before moving to a mansion in Winnipeg.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v3 c31 P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 c33 P4](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0004), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v4 c6 P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000)_
